overview.title: Command overview
overview.description: Live snapshot of fleet health, active dispatches, and delivery reliability.

orders.title: Orders
orders.description: Track queued, live, delayed, and completed dispatches across every zone.

toast.queuedDetail: {entityId} will sync when you are back online.
toast.offline: You are offline. New actions stay on this device.
toast.error: Could not sync. Will retry when the network returns.
toast.incoming: New order on the live board
toast.incomingDetail: {entityId} arrived from WhatsApp and is waiting for a courier.

fleet.title: Fleet
fleet.description: Vehicle availability, zone assignment, and live load across the network.
fleet.empty: No vehicles in the fleet yet. Register one to start assigning couriers.
fleet.addHint: Plate, model, type, capacity, and operating zone.
fleet.editHint: Update plate, type, capacity, zone, and status.
fleet.deleteHint: Any mapped driver is unassigned before the vehicle is removed.
fleet.deleteAssigned: {name} will be unassigned from this vehicle.
fleet.deleteBusy: This courier is on an active route. The vehicle will be unassigned and set inactive instead of deleted.
fleet.plateTaken: That plate number is already registered.
fleet.invalidCapacity: Capacity must be greater than zero.
fleet.deactivated: Vehicle set inactive because a driver is on an active route.

routes.title: Routes
routes.description: Group pending orders by zone and assign them to active vehicles.
routes.empty: No optimized routes yet. Run optimize to assign pending orders by zone.

login.title: Sign in
login.description: Use your dispatch account to open the command floor or driver app.

users.title: Users & fleet mapping
users.description: Add operators, assign Admin / Dispatcher / Driver roles, and map vehicles to couriers.
users.name: Name
users.passwordHint: Leave blank to keep the current password
users.vehicleHint: Pick an unassigned vehicle or register a new one for this driver.
users.confirmDelete: Delete this user? Assigned vehicles will be released.

driver.title: Driver
driver.chooseHint: Pick your profile. This device will keep it for the next shift.
driver.waitingBody: Stay on this screen. New assignments appear here as soon as dispatch sends them.
driver.offlineBody: Switch to Available to receive orders. Location sharing stays paused until you go on duty.
driver.gpsDenied: Location is blocked. Enable GPS to draw your route.
driver.queuedHint: Saved on this phone. It will sync when the network returns.
driver.noVehicleBody: No vehicle assigned to your account. Please contact an administrator.

audio.mutedDetail: New orders still appear on the board. Chimes stay off.
audio.unmutedDetail: You will hear a chime when WhatsApp and API orders arrive.

analytics.title: Analytics & finance
analytics.description: Cash-on-delivery collections, courier performance, and demand across the last two weeks.
analytics.error: Could not load analytics. Check the database connection and retry.

utilization.label: Driver utilization
utilization.hint: Share of on-duty couriers currently assigned

leaderboard.title: Driver performance
leaderboard.hint: Completed jobs, collected cash, and speed over the reporting window.
leaderboard.empty: No completed deliveries in this window.

cash.title: Cash reconciliation
cash.description: Couriers still holding COD payments. Mark settled when cash is handed to management.
cash.empty: All COD cash has been handed over.

settings.title: Settings
settings.description: Workspace preferences for dispatchers on unreliable networks.

language.label: Language
language.detail: Arabic is default; English is secondary with dynamic text direction.

offline.label: Offline cache
offline.detail: Driver actions are stored in IndexedDB and sync automatically when the connection returns.

bandwidth.label: Low-bandwidth mode
bandwidth.detail: Prefers status chips over heavy map tiles.

alerts.label: Alerts
alerts.detail: Delay and geofence events surface in the top bar.

users.label: Users & roles
users.detail: Create accounts, assign RBAC roles, and map vehicles to drivers.

zones.label: Delivery zones
zones.detail: Create, edit, and activate operational areas such as الشعلان and المزة.

vehicleTypes.label: Vehicle types
vehicleTypes.detail: Manage categories like فان صغير, دراجة نارية, and شاحنة تبريد.

catalog.zonesDescription: Operational areas used for vehicle assignment and route optimization.
catalog.zonesEmpty: No zones yet. Add one to start assigning vehicles.
catalog.confirmDeleteZone: Delete this zone? Vehicles using it will keep a detached zone until reassigned.
catalog.typesDescription: Fleet categories with max payload and an icon for dispatch screens.
catalog.typesEmpty: No vehicle types yet. Add one before registering vehicles.
catalog.confirmDeleteType: Delete this vehicle type? Vehicles using it will keep a detached type until reassigned.
catalog.name: Name
catalog.codeAuto: Generated from the first two English letters of the city plus the area (e.g. Damascus + Shaalan → DASH).
catalog.needCatalog: Add at least one active zone and vehicle type in Settings first.
